entities.summary: John Graves Hester is an American former professional baseball catcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Arizona Diamondbacks and the Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim. On August 28, 2009, on his major league debut, he hit a two-run homer in his first Major League at-bat in a game against the Houston Astros.
